def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()
    write_time = {}
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, wt in write_time.items() if wt + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
                del write_time[k]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it (will be re-added at end)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            # If cache is at capacity and key is new, evict LRU
            elif len(cache) >= capacity:
                lru_key = next(iter(cache))
                del cache[lru_key]
                del write_time[lru_key]
            
            # Add the key-value pair (most recently used)
            cache[key] = value
            write_time[key] = t
            
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, wt in write_time.items() if wt + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
                del write_time[k]
            
            # Get the value
            if key in cache:
                results.append(cache[key])
                # Mark as most recently used by moving to end
                cache.move_to_end(key)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
